facts.claim_text: Continue continuous cardiac and hemodynamic monitoring with arterial line and ST-segment surveillance.
facts.text: Continuous cardiac monitoring is currently in place.
notes: concept set by the rule files: cardiac -> other
facts.label: supported
facts.reason: Records show continuous cardiac surveillance with ST Segment Monitoring On and hourly Heart Rhythm documentation, most recently Heart Rhythm SR at 00:00 on 01-16, within hours of decision time.

facts.claim_text: Continue continuous cardiac and hemodynamic monitoring with arterial line and ST-segment surveillance.
facts.text: Hemodynamic monitoring is currently in place.
facts.label: supported
facts.reason: Records show ST Segment Monitoring On and Parameters Checked as 1 at 20:00 on 2169-01-15, within 24 hours of decision time, indicating continuous cardiac/hemodynamic monitoring is in place.

facts.claim_text: Continue continuous cardiac and hemodynamic monitoring with arterial line and ST-segment surveillance.
facts.text: Arterial line is currently in place.
notes: concept set by the rule files: blood_pressure -> other
facts.label: supported

facts.claim_text: Continue continuous cardiac and hemodynamic monitoring with arterial line and ST-segment surveillance.
facts.text: ST-segment surveillance is currently in place.
notes: concept set by the rule files: cardiac -> other
facts.label: supported
facts.reason: Most recent ST monitoring record at 20:00 on 2169-01-15, ~9 hours before decision time, shows ST Segment Monitoring On: 1, indicating surveillance was in place with no subsequent off record.

facts.claim_text: Assess and manage right lower extremity weakness (strength 2/5) with physical therapy and fall precautions.
facts.text: Right lower extremity weakness is present with strength 2/5.
notes: concept set by the rule files: neuro -> other
facts.label: not_addressed

facts.claim_text: Maintain bed rest with fall precautions given bedfast status and right leg weakness.
facts.label: supported
facts.reason: Records explicitly document Braden Activity as Bedfast (1) at multiple times, most recently at 00:00 on 2169-01-16, shortly before the decision time, confirming bedfast status is present.
